findings.issue: The new regression test uses the VM's uncontrolled Math.random() but asserts that the generated seed differs from the saved seed. A valid random draw can equal 424242, causing both static-path tests to fail even when regeneration correctly requests a fresh random seed. Control randomness inside each VM and assert the resulting seed while retaining the existing checks.

summary: Fixed one low-severity flaky regression test by controlling Math.random inside each frontend VM and asserting the exact generated seed while retaining every existing check. The regression went from 0 passing / 2 failing to 2 passing / 0 failing; Git-Bash node scripts/verify.mjs passed 249 Python tests (+26 subtests), 78 frontend tests, 200 Worker tests, browser QA, static sync and npm run check. Preview and live-provider acceptance remain unverified.
